integrity: The four-stratum distribution is proved symbolically and checked by finite exhaustive matrices and one full group-action census. Existing fixed-point-free enumeration is credited. All originality checks are self-review; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Proved for the exponent-p nonabelian group of order p^3, odd primes only. Full histogram refines an already known fixed-point-free first stratum; no claim for other extraspecial groups, even primes, or all endomorphisms. Implicit coverage in older finite-group calculations remains possible.
title: Exact Reidemeister-number distribution for automorphisms of the odd Heisenberg group
